name: lean4monaco
description: Monaco Editor support for the Lean 4 theorem prover.

scripts.demo:install: (cd demo && npm install && npm run build:server)
scripts.demo:setup: concurrently "npm run demo:install" "npm run build" -n install,build -c "bgCyan.bold,bgBlue.bold"
scripts.start: concurrently "tsc -w --preserveWatchOutput" "webpack --watch" "npm run watch:copyfiles" "cd demo && npm run start:client" "cd demo && npm run start:server" -n tsc,webpack,copyfiles,vite,server -c "bgGreen.bold,bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgMagenta.bold"
scripts.test: npm run demo:setup && concurrently --hide 0 --kill-others "npm start" "npm run test:bare" -n server,cypress -s command-cypress
scripts.test:windows:bare: wait-on http://localhost:5173 && CYPRESS_USER_AGENT_OS="Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64" cypress run --browser chromium
scripts.test:windows: npm run demo:setup && concurrently --hide 0 --kill-others "npm start" "npm run test:windows:bare" -n server,cypress -s command-cypress
